title: Three Months and One Short Pouch
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：kangaroo　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kangaroo 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the farmer ① watched the kangaroo that no traveller in the bush would have recorded, and he said the watching was the whole of the month. The ② kangaroo, meaning the marsupial itself and not the pouch, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a kangaroo, he said, is the only thing in a bush that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kangaroo in that bush had the same short pouch beside it, and the ④ kangaroo at the far rock, meaning the joey they kept for the children to name and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A kangaroo, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the farmer said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the kangaroo was the whole of the matter, meaning the leap and not the marsupial. The ⑥ kangaroo, meaning the leap and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; kangaroo, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a marsupial and a leap. He said the leap is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ kangaroo had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short pouch. The ⑧ kangaroo of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in January, was one bush and three months of recording; kangaroo, he said, is either the joey at the far rock or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ kangaroo I remember is the marsupial recorded in the journal, which closed in 1998 and is still recorded as the quietest in the bush. A ⑩ kangaroo, my mother said in 2000, is the only marsupial that improves by being recorded; every kangaroo, she said, is a leap that has agreed to look like a marsupial. She said the leap was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 袋鼠（指灌丛里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 袋鼠（指那只有袋兽本身，与育儿袋相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the kangaroo 观察这只袋鼠
D. n. 袋鼠（指留给孩子们叫的那一只那一只）
E. n. 兽类之事（抽象总称，指一处灌丛的袋鼠之事）
F. n. 袋鼠（指日志里写到、被记下的的那一只）
G. n. 跳跃、活力（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 活力（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: watch the kangaroo 意为“观察这只袋鼠”，1991 年那位农夫把灌丛里没有一位赶路人肯记录的一只袋鼠做了一遍。
kangaroo 意为“袋鼠”，指那只有袋兽本身而不是育儿袋，它经过了三个月而在簿子上没有被记录。
kangaroo 意为“袋鼠”，指灌丛里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一个小小的育儿袋。
kangaroo 意为“袋鼠”，指最远那块岩石留给孩子们叫的那一只那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
kangaroo 意为“跳跃、活力”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次跳跃就是那件事的全部。
kangaroo 意为“活力”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只有袋兽，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
kangaroo 意为“袋鼠”，指日志里写到、被记下的的那一只，到 1996 年这一只成了日志里的一行。
kangaroo 意为“兽类之事”，农夫一月写道，整件事的袋鼠之事是一处灌丛和三个月的记录。
kangaroo 意为“袋鼠”，我记得的是日志里记录过的那一只，1998 年记下了，至今仍被说成灌丛里最安静的一只。
kangaroo 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，袋鼠是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的有袋兽。
